status: exploratory direction amendment specified before these fits; follows the owner's theoretical objection to condition-specific reversals
primary: common positive RT amplitude in all four cells of all retained participants; near RT lower, far RT higher on the increasing physical-distance axis
cohort: primary40; unchanged cleaning and pooled participant × condition × phase Baseline calibration; P011/P033 excluded together
amplitude_prior: HalfNormal(0.15 seconds) independently by participant × cell; permits arbitrarily small response amplitude
comparator: same model with independent Normal(0,0.15 seconds) signed amplitudes; other priors unchanged from joint_logistic_marginal
midpoint_prior: normalized fixed intercept Normal(.5,.5); fixed effects Normal(0,.5); independent participant coefficient SDs HalfNormal(.35), all four factorial coefficients
log_width_prior: normalized fixed intercept Normal(log(1/6),.7); fixed effects Normal(0,.7); independent participant coefficient SDs HalfNormal(.5), all four factorial coefficients
corrected_intercept_prior: independent Normal(0,.2 seconds) by participant × cell
baseline_prior: independent Normal(.6,.4 seconds) by participant × cell; observations from all nominal SOA labels pooled
likelihood: exact Gaussian sufficient statistics including within-cell SSE; analytically integrate baseline, offset and amplitude; positive model adds log(2)+log Phi(unrestricted conditional amplitude mean/SD)
conditional_draws: exact positive truncated-normal amplitude; conditional Gaussian offset and baseline; independent random seed after NUTS
full_fit: 4 chains; 3000 tune/3000 retained draws, target .99; extend once to 6000 tune/6000 draws only for failed diagnostics
gate: no divergences, all parameter rank Rhat <=1.01, bulk and tail ESS >=400
held_distance_comparison: positive versus matched unrestricted model; five held-distance folds; all AT trials at each held distance omitted across people/cells; all independent Baseline calibration retained
CV_sampling: 4 chains, 1500 tune/1500 retained draws; once-only 3000 tune/6000 retained extension for predictive Rhat >1.01, bulk/tail ESS <400 or any divergence
inference: all Condition, Phase and interaction contrasts for midpoint and normalized sharpness, plus simple contrasts; preserve response-level contrasts; no model selection by significance
limits: direction is a hypothesis imposed before fitting this extension; a positive amplitude credible interval cannot validate the sign; equal direction does not imply equal numerical plateau heights; no forced width, plateau observations, midpoint bounds, or post hoc curve flipping
stopping: complete primary fit and all ten prediction folds regardless of p values or posterior direction; retain failed diagnostics
